notes: 24 modules: fit + fight per stage. APPLIES THE ARCADE SESSION STANDARD (specs/27, data/arcade-session-standards.json). FIT modules now carry a counted `prescription` (sets x reps/sec + category + tier); stored numbers are the NORMAL baseline, the app re-resolves easy/hard from the volume ladder by tier+category. FIGHT modules carry `round_source`, a `canonical_map` (thematic sword/implement drill -> canonical discipline or conditioning equivalent), per-round `combo_spec` (implement-swing rounds are cue-based; fencing thrust rounds generate numbered straights), and a `finishers` block (explosive bodyweight, capped, counting toward the plyo cap). Tier map: T1 stages 1-3, T2 4-6, T3 7-9, T4 10-12. Exercise/drill vocabulary grounded in the deep-research report (The Bioneer strongman club/mace/carry work, SuperheroJacked rep bands, HEMA guard/footwork for Casca/Griffith, sledgehammer vs steel-mace mechanics). SAFETY: Eclipse stages 9-11 + boss 12 carry 'eclipse_safety': true — targets are PREDETERMINED and volume-capped; never 'max until collapse'. Split stages 4-11 are SKILL-FIRST (fight = morning, fit = evening). Fight round counts/lengths resolve from campaign.difficulty_scaling.fight unless a module overrides (boss does).

both_rules.description: When a stage is run as BOTH (fit + fight combined).
both_rules.sequencing: Skill/fight first while fresh, then fit. Stages 4-11 are already skill-first split (fight = AM, fit = PM); stages 1-3 and 12 are single-session, so BOTH runs fight -> fit back-to-back.
both_rules.shared_plyo_cap: The campaign plyo foot-contact cap is counted ACROSS the whole session — fight finishers + fit explosive share it; if combined would exceed it, the fit explosive block trims first.
both_rules.volume_sanity: In a single-session BOTH (stages 1-3, 12), fit accessory volume may drop one notch so two full high-volume blocks aren't stacked. On eclipse stages (9-11) the eclipse volume caps already bound the combined session.
both_rules.readiness: A BOTH day is a HARD day: readiness gate applies before starting, and it won't schedule back-to-back with another hard day. Eclipse stages (9-11) and the boss additionally run the enhanced readiness checks (heat, recent illness, hydration).
both_rules.announcer: States the combined plan up front (e.g. 'Stage 7: Dragonslayer. Fight — 5 rounds. Then Fit — Carry the Great Sword, 5 workouts.').
